item.title: macOS Container Machines
item.description:

item.title: German ruling declares Google liable for false answers in AI Overviews
item.description:
📝 Ask about this article… Search A German court has ruled that Google is directly liable for what its AI search overviews say. Ad AI overviews aren't search results Google's AI overviews work nothing like traditional search results, the court argues. The court rejected this.
🔗 Read more: https://the-decoder.com/landmark-german-ruling-declares-googles-ai-overviews-are-googles-own-words-and-makes-it-liable-for-false-answers/

item.title: RIP software hackathons. Long live the hardware hackathon
item.description:
📝 We wired a Raspberry Pi into the phone which interfaced with all of its IO and communicated with our server via a single websocket connection which controlled everything from two-way audio, the bell ringer (with custom frequency and audio patterns) and the hangup switch. Something which would have been unheard of just 12 months ago has become today's reality. This leaves free mental RAM to actually faff with hardware and how it interfaces with the physical world.
🔗 Read more: https://blog.oscars.dev/posts/rip-software-hackathons-long-live-the-hardware-hackathon/
